chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali Al-Washa, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Is'haq ibn Ammar, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

Had it not been for what Allah, Mighty and Majestic, bestowed upon the people of the 'Tawaaf of the Women', the man would have returned to his wife, and his wife would not have been permissible to him.

key_terms.طَوَافِ النِّسَاءِ: Tawaaf of the Women; a specific ritual or social practice referenced in Shia jurisprudence regarding marital status.
key_terms.عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ: Mighty and Majestic; an honorific title for Allah.
key_terms.لَيْسَ يَحِلُّ لَهُ: Not permissible to him; indicating a state of prohibition or invalidity in the marital bond.

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on a man returning to his wife after divorce if the 'Tawaaf of the Women' applies?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) highlights the divine mercy in the institution of *Talaq Raj'i* (revocable divorce), where the wife remains in the marital home during the *Iddah* period. This period of 'circulation' or continued cohabitation allows the husband to reconcile without a new contract, preventing the marriage from becoming permanently forbidden as it would in a *Talaq Ba'in* (irrevocable divorce). This ruling underscores the flexibility in Shia jurisprudence to preserve family bonds while maintaining clear legal boundaries regarding remarriage.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al hassan Bin Ali Al Washa, from Abdullah Bin Sinan, from Is’haq Bin Ammar, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Had Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic not Favoured upon the people with the Tawaaf Al-Nisaa, the man would have returned to his wife, and his wife would not have been Permissible unto him’.
en.sarwar: 3. A number of our people have narrated from and from al-Hassan ibn Ali al-Washsha’ from ‘Abd Allah ibn Sinan from Ishaq ibn ‘Ammar who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
If Allah, most Majestic, most Glorious, did not grant a favor to people with Tawaf al-Nisa’ a man would return to his family and his wife becomes unlawful for him.’”
